## overview 

- Types: [[discrete random variable]] or [[continuous random variable]]

## Properties
for discrete and continuous ==random== variables 
### When scaling a random variable multiplicatively
scaling random variable A by a factor of n
- **[[Variance]]**: 
	- $Var(nA) = n^2 Var(A)$

- **Expectation**:
	- $E(nA) = nE(A)$
